items.description:
PremFresh is the retail seafood arm of Premier Fishing, selling fresh and frozen export-grade seafood from its Kromboom Gardens Centre store in Crawford. The range covers fish, shellfish and other seafood products, and the business also runs an online shop for customers who prefer to order ahead.

Online orders placed through PremFresh can be collected from either this Crawford store or the company's Plumstead branch, and customers can create an account to manage their orders. Enquiries can be made by phone or email directly to the Kromboom store. It suits households and caterers around Crawford looking for export-grade fresh and frozen seafood close to home.

Premier Hardware is a hardware supplier based in Oryx Park, Brackenfell Industria, specialising in shower hardware and bathroom fittings manufactured from brass, zinc and copper alloys. Its catalogue also covers balustrades, office and shopfront hardware, sliding systems, and a black range of finishes for a more contemporary look.

The business says it supplies high-quality products along with the technical knowledge and levels of service required by its growing customer base, and a full catalogue can be downloaded from its website. It suits architects, contractors and homeowners in the northern suburbs who need bathroom and shopfront hardware sourced locally rather than imported piece by piece.

SBG Cape Town is a martial arts gym in Sunnydale offering Mixed Martial Arts, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, kickboxing for MMA and submission wrestling, run under the coaching methodology of Straight Blast Gym International. Progress is measured by one standard: successfully executing a technique against an uncooperative opponent, and classes run for both adults and children.

The gym trains people of all ages, backgrounds and goals, from aspiring MMA athletes and BJJ competitors to anyone in their fifties looking for a fun way to get back in shape. Coaches and senior students help newer members build their skills in what the gym describes as a fun, safe and healthy environment. It suits beginners and experienced martial artists alike in the Sunnydale area.

Sun Valley Primary School is a public primary school in Sun Valley, established in 1977 and offering Grade R to Grade 7. The school describes its vision for learners as building confident, creative team players who are goal-orientated and reflect the school's core values within a culturally diverse learning community.

Sun Valley Primary provides what it calls an integrated and co-operative learning environment, where children are nurtured and encouraged to develop relevant skills, concepts and attitudes. The aim is for each learner to grow into a responsible, caring and self-motivated person capable of contributing to and upholding an equal society. It suits families in Sun Valley and the surrounding Fish Hoek valley looking for a values-driven primary school close to home.

Two Gingers Gember Distillery is a craft gin distillery in Muizenberg, founded in 2022 as a project built around purity, connection and flavour, and inspired by classic distilling methods. Its range includes the Pink Pomelo Gin, Spice Route Gin and a Four Seasons Collection, alongside a Four Seasons Miniatures range for gift-giving.

The distillery was named Best Craft Gin in Africa in 2023 by Gin Guide, and its Cape Cheers Gin Festival helped set a Guinness World Records title for the largest gin tasting. Visitors can book tastings and cocktail experiences at the distillery, which suits gin enthusiasts looking for a locally made spirit with a story behind it, alongside interactive distillery tours.

Brackenfell Steel is a steel supplier in Brackenfell Industrial, established in 1994, selling new and re-usable steel with same-day cutting and bending of reinforcing steel to schedule. The business says this fast turnaround has helped it grow to more than 50 employees, and it also trades on Saturdays for customers who cannot get there during the week.

The company positions itself as a guide through the steel supply chain, tailoring product solutions to each customer's specific challenge rather than offering one-size-fits-all stock. Enquiries can be made by phone or through its Facebook page. It suits builders, fabricators and contractors in the northern suburbs who need steel cut and bent to size without a long wait.

Brand Collective is a multi-branded fashion and footwear store in Mainstream Mall, Hout Bay, next to Woolworths, stocking a range of on-trend, quality streetwear brands for men, women and children. The store describes itself as living and breathing fashion, sport and the outdoors, and it showcases leading international brands available in stores across South Africa.

Shoppers can browse urban street style labels across the whole family's wardrobe in one store, rather than hunting between several specialist outlets, and online orders can also be placed through the brand's own online store. It suits Hout Bay residents who want on-trend sport and streetwear brands without having to travel into the city centre.

Vortex Factory Shop is a cleaning products factory outlet on Wetton Road in Wetton, stocking an extensive range of household cleaning products for indoor and outdoor use. The range includes imported raw materials and products for laundry, kitchen and general household cleaning, as well as specialised car-care products.

Customers are known to appreciate the friendly and helpful staff, who offer quick service and recommendations on which products work best for a given job. Shoppers are encouraged to try the scrubbing brushes and spray bottles that visitors rate highly for their value. It suits households in Wetton and the surrounding southern suburbs looking for bulk cleaning supplies at factory-outlet prices.

Bergvliet Dental & Medical is a multi-practitioner practice on Bergvliet Road in Bergvliet, bringing four dentists, two oral hygienists and an occupational therapist together under one roof. The practice says it aims to meet the needs of the whole family, from routine dental care and oral hygiene through to occupational therapy support.

Patients can reach the practice by phone between 8am and 5pm, or by email, to book an appointment with one of its dentists or allied practitioners. It suits families in Bergvliet and the surrounding southern suburbs who want dental and related healthcare services available together in a single practice, rather than visiting several separate providers.

Big Boy Crockery is a homeware retailer and importer and wholesaler of glassware on Imam Haron Road in Lansdowne, stocking cutlery, crockery, cookware, dinnerware, serving platters and general kitchenware. The business is also listed as a household goods wholesaler and a supplier of linens and plastic products, giving it a wider range than a typical homeware shop.

It trades Monday to Thursday from 8am to 5pm, Friday from 8am to 5pm with a midday break, and Saturday mornings until 3pm. It suits households, caterers and small retailers in Lansdowne looking to buy crockery, glassware and kitchenware at wholesale-style prices in one stop.

items.description:
Russells is a furniture and homeware retailer with a branch inside Grand Central Shopping Centre in Eerste River, trading under the Pepkor Lifestyle group of stores. The branch is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, Saturday mornings until 1pm, and Sunday mornings from 9am to 1pm, closing on public holidays.

Shoppers can browse the store's range of living room, bedroom and dining furniture alongside household appliances and electronics, with a store account and credit application available in branch for those who want to spread the cost of larger purchases. A catalogue of current specials is also on display in store. It suits households in Eerste River looking to furnish a home room by room without travelling into central Cape Town, with the option to apply for credit on the spot.

items.description:
Simon's Town Pharmacy at SPAR operates inside the SPAR supermarket on St George's Street in Simon's Town, as a member of the WeCare Pharmacy Network. The pharmacy is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturday mornings until 2pm, and is closed on Sundays.

Being part of a wider pharmacy network, customers can sign up to receive product promotions and health savings directly from the pharmacy, and the WeCare group also publishes its own digital health and lifestyle magazine for members to read. Alongside dispensing, the pharmacy offers the everyday retail pharmacy services customers expect from a SPAR-based outlet. It suits Simon's Town residents and visitors who want pharmacy care available in the same visit as their grocery shopping, rather than making a separate trip across town.

items.description:
Tang is a modern-Asian restaurant and bar at the V&A Waterfront, its name drawn from the ancient Chinese dynasty that prized sensory pleasure and creativity. The Cape Town restaurant opened in December 2022 in a waterside space with views over the harbour, yacht basin and Table Mountain, and was named Africa's Best New Restaurant 2023 at the World Culinary Awards the following year.

The interior is clad in pale oak and marble with touches of cherry blossom pink for a lighter, more tropical feel, and keeps a signature marble waterfall, a Champagne fridge and a walk-in wine cellar as its centrepieces. Its alfresco tables sit right on the ocean's edge, giving diners a multi-sensory setting to go with the kitchen's modern takes on classic Asian dishes. It suits special-occasion diners at the Waterfront looking for a glamorous setting alongside their meal, with harbourside tables a particular draw at sunset.

items.description:
The Crazy Store Ottery is a discount variety store trading inside the Ottery Pick n Pay Hypermarket on Ottery Road. The branch is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturday from 9am to 5pm, and Sunday mornings until 2pm.

Shelves cover a wide spread of everyday categories, from toys for girls and kids and plastic homeware through to gifts, stationery, home accessories and home decor. The store also stocks party supplies and a costume range that includes Halloween costumes each year. Being inside the Ottery Hyper complex alongside the Pick n Pay, it gives shoppers in the surrounding suburb a nearby stop for small household buys, kids' gifts and party planning without a trip to a bigger mall further away. It suits parents restocking school stationery or putting together party bags on a tight budget, and anyone grabbing a last-minute gift while doing the weekly grocery run next door.

items.description:
Wimpy Ottery Centre is a branch of the family restaurant chain inside Ottery Centre on Woodlands Road, open every day of the week from 8am to 7pm. The restaurant is known for its all-day breakfasts, burgers, toasted sandwiches and thick milkshakes, including the Famous Wimpy Grill alongside the wider breakfast and lunch menu.

Diners can eat in, order a takeaway at the counter, or place an order online for delivery, and the branch offers a Braille menu for visually impaired customers alongside its standard printed menu. Being inside Ottery Centre keeps it close to the other shops in the Ottery Hyper complex, making it a convenient stop before or after a grocery run. It suits families looking for an all-day breakfast or a casual burger lunch in Ottery without having to drive further afield, with both dine-in and delivery options available throughout the day.
